1.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers

probes.text: Four boys finish a long Dungeons & Dragons game in a suburban basement, then pedal off home through the dark.
A nervous girl in a hospital gown wanders into a small roadside diner, and the owner sits her down with food.
Inside a government laboratory, staff examine a strange organic substance oozing from a wall down in the basement.

2.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street

fine_only.text: The boys argue in Mike's basement about what to do with the girl they brought home.

probes.text: Hopper sits with lab staff and watches security footage from the front gate on the night Will vanished.
The boys sneak Eleven into their school after hours, hoping the ham radio there is powerful enough.
Joyce tears the wallpaper off her living room wall, following her son's voice coming through it.
Steve argues with Nancy, worried mainly about getting in trouble with his father rather than her missing friend.

5.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat

probes.text: The boys trek through the woods in a line, each of them watching the needle of a compass.
Eleven wanders into a grocery store and walks out with an armful of stolen Eggo waffle boxes.
After fleeing on their bikes, the kids hole up in a junkyard to wait things out.
Inside the Byers house, Nancy and Jonathan each draw a blade across their palm.
